pages.text: The Merchant's stock changes, but several goods appear only through his trade screen. Gold buys practical tools; his rare offers demand diamonds or Golden Ogre Teeth.$(br2)No optional combat mod is required to use these items.

pages.title: Useful Stock
pages.text: The Bog-Eye Charm locates nearby unopened loot. The Hookblade and stew serve more direct needs. A sealed King's Tribute Bundle contains a weighted selection of Ogre goods.

pages.title: Premium Stock
pages.text: Expensive, uncommon, and sold one opportunity at a time.
